# Hackr.io

> > Hackr.io is an AI-powered tech learning hub offering curated courses, tutorials, and expert resources across programming languages and development tools.

Hackr.io aggregates the best online programming courses, coding tutorials, and developer resources to help learners master technologies from Python and JavaScript to game development and AI coding assistants. The platform serves beginners through intermediate developers with ranked guides, tool comparisons, and certification pathways.

## Core Learning Resources

- [Hackr.io | Ultimate Tech Learning Hub](https://hackr.io): Hackr.io homepage: AI-powered tech learning hub with tutorials, mentors, and coding resources.
- [Hackr.io | Online Programming Courses](https://hackr.io/courses): Course catalog featuring Python, JavaScript, web development, and multi-language programming tutorials.

## Programming Languages & Frameworks

- [The 10 Best JavaScript Frameworks to Learn in 2026](https://hackr.io/blog/best-javascript-frameworks): Guide to JavaScript frameworks: React, Astro, SolidJS for web development projects.
- [10 Best Web Development Frameworks in 2026 [Updated]](https://hackr.io/blog/web-development-frameworks): Comprehensive guide to top 10 web development frameworks for frontend and backend.
- [Best Python IDEs in 2026 [Includes AI-Native Editors]](https://hackr.io/blog/best-python-ide): Evaluation of top 8 Python IDEs: VS Code, PyCharm, Cursor with AI capabilities comparison.
- [7 Best Python Certifications For All Levels [2026 Update]](https://hackr.io/blog/python-certification): Guide to Python certifications including PCEP from Python Institute for skill validation.
- [The 8 Best Programming Languages for Game Development](https://hackr.io/blog/best-programming-language-for-games): Comparison of game development languages: C++, C#, GDScript, Rust, JavaScript for game engines.

## Developer Tools & Productivity

- [30 Best VSCode Extensions To Boost Productivity](https://hackr.io/blog/best-vscode-extensions): Guide to 30 VSCode extensions including GitHub Copilot and Tabnine for developer productivity.
- [The 20 Best VSCode Themes in 2026](https://hackr.io/blog/best-vscode-themes): Curated list of 20 VSCode themes including Dracula and Ayu for code editor customization.
- [7 Best AI Coding Assistants In 2026 [Free + Paid]](https://hackr.io/blog/ai-coding-assistants): Comparison of AI coding assistants: GitHub Copilot, Amazon CodeWhisperer, Tabnine.
- [Top Linux Distributions for Developers: A Complete Ranking](https://hackr.io/blog/best-linux-distro-for-programming): Ranked guide to Linux distros for programming: Ubuntu, Manjaro, Arch, openSUSE, Fedora.

## Learning Platforms & Resources

- [The Best Online Learning Platforms of 2026 [Ranked]](https://hackr.io/blog/best-online-learning-platforms): Ranked comparison of Coursera, Udemy, Udacity, edX, and Skillshare for creative and career growth.
- [Best Coding Apps in 2026: Best Apps to Learn Code](https://hackr.io/blog/best-coding-apps): Review of top 11 coding apps including Mimo, Khan Academy, Sololearn for mobile learning.
